requirements.text: Provide an explicit checking-to-in_progress rework operation with a required reason and current-cycle fail/uncovered precondition, without repurposing blocked.
Introduce schema v2 verification revisions so only current-cycle evidence and checks can satisfy coverage, TDD, and finish gates.
Preserve current checks separately from immutable check-history snapshots and make rework crash-recoverable and idempotent.
Provide explicit idempotent v1-to-v2 migration while preserving immutable v1 history and making old readers fail closed on v2.
Expose revision-aware rework, history, migration, orient, and agent-routing behavior through the public CLI and packaged skills.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Two consecutive checking-to-rework-to-in_progress loops succeed, and stale prior-revision proof cannot finish the current revision.
Migration is explicit and idempotent, preserves v1 immutable history byte-for-byte, and validates mixed-version history as revision 0.
Failure injection at every rework write boundary recovers with one logical snapshot, one revision increment, and no lost rows.
Focused and full tests, type checks, build, plugin packaging, plugin checks, doctor, and validator pass.
